qt: to the Commission Loránt Vincze (PPE), Łukasz Kohut (PPE), Anna-Maja Henriksson (Renew), Vicent Marzà Ibáñez (Verts/ALE), Herbert Dorfmann (PPE), Pascal Arimont (PPE), Hannes Heide (S&D), Waldemar Tomaszewski (ECR), Sander Smit (ECR), Eszter Lakos (PPE), Kinga Kollár (PPE), Gabriella Gerzsenyi (PPE), Dóra Dávid (PPE), Csaba Bogdán (PPE), András Tivadar Kulja (PPE), Viktor Weisz (PPE), Ilhan Kyuchyuk (Renew), Raquel García Hermida-Van Der Walle (Renew), Oihane Agirregoitia Martínez (Renew), Rasmus Andresen (Verts/ALE), Zsuzsanna Borvendég (ESN), Iuliu Winkler (PPE), Fernand Kartheiser (NI) Subject:

Ahead of her State of the Union address, in a reply to a letter signed by 28 Members of the Minority Intergroup, President Ursula von der Leyen stated that she had taken note of the request for a European strategy for traditional national and linguistic minorities and had shared it with the competent members of the Commission and its services. 1.

Can the Commission provide a substantive follow-up to this request, including which Commissioners and services are responsible for examining it, and what concrete steps are envisaged towards developing such a strategy?

In the light of the recent Court of Justice of the European Union’s ruling1 concerning the legal effects of Article 2 of the Treaty on European Union, does the Commission consider that the ruling provides further grounds for strengthening EU efforts to protect and promote traditional national and linguistic minorities, and will it consider integrating their protection more systematically into relevant EU policies, initiatives and monitoring activities?

The Court made clear that respect for these values cannot be reduced to an obligation that applies only during the accession process to be then abandoned. Importantly, this applies to all Member States. How will the Commission ensure that the rights of traditional national and linguistic minorities are upheld?
The Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) Judgment in C-769/22- Commission v Hungary (Valeurs de l’Union). 1
